title: Syntheses, DNA interactions, and photodynamic antimicrobial properties of near-infrared indolium carbocyanine dyes
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01566B, Paper

A di-cationic indolium heptamethine carbocyanine dye equipped with a quaternary ammonium group is non-toxic in the dark but significantly reduces the survival of Gram-negative bacteria when irradiated at 780 nm.
